column1: # Proposed triage of the open issues in LinuxHello/linux-hello, 2026-11-04. Review, edit, then
#   make triage           show what would change
#   make triage APPLY=1   change it on GitHub
# Columns (tab-separated): issue, status, priority, blocked by (comma-separated issue numbers or -), note.
# status: needs-brief | ready | in-progress | in-review | blocked. priority: now | next | later.
# "in-review" on an issue without a PR means: the maintainer decides (see note).
